title: HP OMEN 35L Liquid Cooler AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D 16GB DDR5 1TB SSD RTX 5070 - $3348.80 Shipped @ HP eBay
body:

[asrey1975] HP don't even list any PC option for RTX 5090 GPU, looks like they dont sell desktops with that chip anymore. You can still buy a RTX 5090 at Dell if you have a spare $12,000 burning a hole in your pocket right now… FML.
[jasswolf] You and I have a very different idea of a massive eBay deal… dark times when a GPU only takes up a third of the PC cost.
Don't get fleeced by HP here, this is honestly the domain of an RTX 5070 Ti system.

1 x 16 GB
yeah lol single channel ftw

NVIDIA appreciates
